risks.title: Device evidence is PC/native-canvas replay, not physical-device or independent art review
risks.assessment: Controller and renderer behavior is strongly covered by six focused contracts, 356 records across three workflows, stable source hashes, zero browser errors, and 240x320 native PNG replay. risks.title: Automated v5 coverage does not test strategic defer/lock play or human-duration balance
risks.assessment: The 32-game run is workflow/exception coverage with 32 unique seeds, 3,804 battles, and 43 codec roundtrips. It does not establish that an active lock strategy is desirable or that v5 changes natural-end pacing.
risks.re_review_condition: Add strategic-policy experiments and human-duration whole-game evidence before making those broader claims.

risks.title: Fairness evidence is bounded and cannot support whole-roster balance claims
risks.assessment: The lineage/route accounting is internally consistent and the 16-arm x100-seed v4 endpoint-role comparison is honest about its limits. It is not acquisition-timing, whole-roster, or whole-game balance proof; Ninetales/Lapras differences cannot be reduced to evolution capability.
risks.re_review_condition: Use whole-roster and live-acquisition experiments before claiming global price or strength fairness.

risks.title: Eevee branch clarity remains unresolved by design
risks.assessment: The current deterministic route reaches Vaporeon while Jolteon and Flareon remain evolved but unreachable direct-purchase terminals. The docs explicitly flag this rather than claiming a true branch choice.
risks.re_review_condition: Implement a real three-target branch with target-pool checks, or consistently label the siblings as direct-purchase branch products.

evidence: sim/tactics.py gates evolution choices exclusively to tactics_v5 while retaining v4 pacing behavior for v5.
sim/shop.py::try_combine performs eligibility and inventory-return checks before mutation, supports lock-aware recursion, explicit species/UID selection, and single-step mode.

tools/acceptance/demo.py::_evolution_preview rehearses on deep copies; act_buy separates auto/defer final capacity; act_evolve consumes the selected UID plus deterministic others for exactly one merge.
tools/acceptance/device_controls.py binds confirmation to save sequence and UID, commits under the demo lock, rejects stale state, and blocks duplicate release through the transaction input window.

tools/acceptance/session_save.py makes boolean evolution_locked mandatory for every v5 owned record, rejects it on old rules and invalid terminal/trade locks, and leaves the legacy v4 fingerprint unavailable to v5.

tests/test_evolution_choices.py and tests/test_evolution_device.py cover recursive preview, read-only behavior, fourth-copy selection, capacity/stock, inheritance/guard invalidation, atomic save, old rules, v4/v5 event equivalence, golden replay, cancellation, stale sequence, and duplicate release.
The probe derives partitions from complete lineage and checks all 84 templates; endpoint triplication uses the real try_combine.
Route accounting distinguishes invested gold, cumulative pool occupancy, and minimum sequential peak occupancy.
The acquisition model explicitly declares full-pool, uniform-within-tier, with-replacement assumptions and excludes live-game dynamics.
Battle evidence predeclares tactics_v4, 16 arms and 100 independent seeds; side swaps are symmetry checks only; limitations forbid whole-roster and evolution-only causal claims.
The separate v4/v5 same-input test covers routing/event equivalence over 20 seeds without mislabeling the bounded fairness battle as that test.
